comment: Blood Sun step 5 (USER D1, design §9.1): life 3, Grim Tutor in hand, four lands, opponent at 3, the only Bolt at the BOTTOM of a Swamp library. Grim Tutor would fetch the Bolt and kill -- but its 'You lose 3 life' resolves first and kills us (own death live), so it is never cast: no win, life stays 3. d3, budget 100.
